origin_rule: latest Monday on or before issue date minus 1 day with all 15 inputs present, at most 14 days before the issue date
target_quantity: 30-day change in reservoir storage, percentage points of the capacity in force at the origin (not water-surface elevation)

sources.provider: California Data Exchange Center (CDEC), CA Department of Water Resources
sources.storage_sensor: 15 (reservoir storage, daily, acre-feet; end of day)
sources.snow_sensor: 82 (snow water content, adjusted/revised, daily, inches; morning reading)

assumptions: Storage inputs use CDEC daily sensor 15 end-of-day values through the origin date only.
Snow inputs use the basin index of core pillows (frozen WY<=2023 rule) through origin minus 1 day only.
Recent sensor 82 values may still be revised; the model was trained mostly on fully revised values.
The capacity denominator is the capacity in force on the origin date (data/capacity_history.csv) and is assumed unchanged through the target date.
NASA POWER weather is not an input of the frozen v2 primary model and is not used.
No planned releases, operations, forecasts of precipitation or interventions are represented.
disclaimers: Experimental research forecast. Not operational water-management advice, not a water-supply outlook, and not a flood or dam-safety product.
The model has not been prospectively validated.
90% intervals are retrospectively calibrated on historical out-of-fold residuals; their future coverage is not established.
Folsom (FOL) intervals covered only about 75% of outcomes in the 2024-2025 backtest.
These records are new forecasts, not held-out test predictions, and are not part of the frozen v2 evaluation.

warnings: Stale origin: the newest eligible Monday is 13 days before the issue date; a more recent Monday lacked required observations.
Latest snowpack observation (2026-11-12) is more than 5 days before the issue date.
